title: KeySource seam + LocalKeySource
summary: Define the KeySource interface (getPublicKeyDer() -> SPKI DER Uint8Array, signDigest(digest) -> ECDSA DER Uint8Array) and implement LocalKeySource over a secp256k1 private key using @noble/curves. LocalKeySource must emulate AWS KMS output shapes exactly: SPKI (X.509 SubjectPublicKeyInfo) for the public key and ECDSA DER for the signature.
acceptance: LocalKeySource.getPublicKeyDer() returns valid SPKI DER; signDigest() returns valid ECDSA DER; a unit test round-trips the public key through derive-address (once T3 exists).
notes: No KMS, no AWS SDK here. Keep it pure and deterministic (fixed key in tests).

title: ECDSA DER codec + s-normalisation
summary: Pure functions over Uint8Array/BigInt using @noble/curves secp256k1: parseSignatureFromDER (-> {r,s}), encodeSignatureToDER, and normaliseS (if s > n/2 return n - s else s). No I/O, no env, no clock.
acceptance: normaliseS flips a hand-built high-s signature to the lower half; round-trip encode(decode(x)) === x; unit tests cover high-s and low-s inputs.
notes: This is the classic KMS bug fix (execution_plan §12b, owner-a-tasks A13). Keep it pure — v-recovery lives in T5, not here.

title: SPKI DER public key -> Ethereum address
summary: Parse SPKI DER, extract the secp256k1 point (uncompressed 04||x||y via a minimal ASN.1 read — not a fixed tail), compute keccak256(x||y)[12..] and return the EIP-55 checksummed address via viem getAddress.
acceptance: Given a known private key, derive-address matches the address viem computes from that key (byte-for-byte, checksummed). Unit test with a fixed vector.
notes: Custody proof (A11) depends on this being exact. Compare against EXPECTED_SIGNER_ADDRESS in T11.

title: EIP-3009 typed data + digest
summary: Build TransferWithAuthorization(from,to,value,validAfter,validBefore,nonce) typed data and compute its EIP-712 digest with viem hashTypedData. Domain fields: name <- challenge.extra.name, version <- challenge.extra.version, chainId <- challenge.chainId, verifyingContract <- challenge.asset. value is a base-unit string at 6 decimals. Assert the live challenge matches expected constants and refuse on mismatch (SIGNER_DOMAIN_MISMATCH).
acceptance: digest is byte-identical to viem signTypedData over the same typed data; a domain mismatch throws SIGNER_DOMAIN_MISMATCH (403).
notes: Uses TransferWithAuthorizationTypedData from packages/contracts/src/types.ts. Value stays a decimal string; encode as BigInt for the digest. This is the load-bearing domain guard (execution_plan §19.4).

title: parse -> normalise -> recover -> header
summary: Given a KeySource, a digest, and the expected derivedAddress: get ECDSA DER from signDigest, parse to r,s, normalise s, recover v by trying both parities and matching the recovered address against derivedAddress (noble secp256k1 addRecoveryBit + recoverPublicKey), then emit { v, r: hex, s: hex } and the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header.
acceptance: For a fixed key, pipeline output is byte-identical to viem signTypedData for the same digest; both v=27 and v=28 paths exercised; a high-s DER input is normalised and still recovers.
notes: Verify the exact PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload schema against the x402 spec before finalising the header string — do not guess it (see plan_overview.md open details). KmsKeySource (T6) and LocalKeySource (T1) both feed this unchanged.

title: KmsKeySource (AWS SDK wrapper)
summary: Implement KeySource over @aws-sdk/client-kms: getPublicKeyDer via GetPublicKey (returns DER bytes) and signDigest via Sign (MessageType DIGEST, SigningAlgorithm ECDSA_SHA_256) returning the DER signature.
acceptance: Typechecks; maps AWS errors to AppError SIGNER_KMS_FAILED (502). Exercise only when credentials exist (human-blocked), but the code is complete and swappable.
notes: Uses ECC_SECG_P256K1 / SIGN_VERIFY key spec. Never log the full key id. The offline path is covered by LocalKeySource, so no credentials are needed to merge this.

title: seven-refusal hard-invariant rail
summary: Pure refusal checks over a parsed sign request + an immutable pinned map { mandateId -> { settlementRecipient, hardMaxTotal } } loaded from env at boot (never the request): SIGNER_UNPINNED_MANDATE, SIGNER_WRONG_RECIPIENT, SIGNER_CEILING, SIGNER_WRONG_FROM, SIGNER_WRONG_CHAIN, SIGNER_WINDOW (validBefore-validAfter>600), SIGNER_REPLAY (requestId already signed, 409).
acceptance: Each of the seven conditions returns its exact ErrorCode via AppError.signerRefusal; the pinned map is read-only and loaded once.
notes: Reuse ErrorCode + AppError.signerRefusal from packages/contracts/src/errors.ts. Replay needs a per-process seen-requestId set. These hold even if policy-service is compromised (execution_plan §12b 2.2).

title: Rewrite signer app (/health + /sign)
summary: Replace the stub handlers: /health exposes { ok, derivedAddress, kmsKeyId (masked), chainId } with NO stub flag; POST /sign validates { requestId, mandateId, typedData }, runs the rail (T7), builds digest (T4), signs via the pipeline (T5), and returns SignResponse { requestId, header, signature:{v,r,s}, signerAddress, signedAt }.
acceptance: Shape matches api-contracts.md §4; the old stub.test.ts is replaced; stub flag and fixed dummy header are gone.
notes: Keep buildSignerApp(opts) returning a FastifyInstance so tests inject a LocalKeySource without binding a port (conventions.md §3). Owner B's signerClient.ts depends on this shape — do NOT change the request/response shape, and flag any move to Owner B.

title: Three offline signature vectors (A13)
summary: Write the three A13 vectors: (1) fixed key -> viem signTypedData vs the same digest through LocalKeySource + the pipeline -> byte-identical; (2) hand-built high-s DER -> normalisation flips it and v still recovers; (3) both v=27 and v=28 cases.
acceptance: All three pass offline, no KMS, no network. This is the highest-value test in the project.
notes: TDD: these were planned as the seam's deliverable (handoff + approved plan). Write them against T5 once it exists.

title: Seven refusal unit tests (A14)
summary: Unit-test all seven refusals at the pure-rail level and assert the corresponding HTTP status/code at the app level (403 for six, 409 for SIGNER_REPLAY) via app.inject.
acceptance: Seven refusals each assert the exact ErrorCode; replay returns 409.
notes: Matches owner-a-tasks A14 table and api-contracts.md §4. Note the doc says 'these five' while listing seven — seven is correct.

title: main.ts boot assertion + key-source selection
summary: At boot: derive the address from the key source (T3), assert it equals EXPECTED_SIGNER_ADDRESS character-for-character, and refuse to start on mismatch. Select the key source: SIGNER_KEY_SOURCE=kms -> KmsKeySource; =local -> LocalKeySource but ONLY if ALLOW_LOCAL_KEY_SOURCE=true (else refuse to start). Load PINNED_MANDATES from env. Remove the old stub guard.
acceptance: Mismatched EXPECTED_SIGNER_ADDRESS prevents startup; local mode refuses to start without ALLOW_LOCAL_KEY_SOURCE=true.
notes: Keep main.ts to env-read + listen only (conventions.md §1). EXPECTED_SIGNER_ADDRESS replaces the 0x9f6B...1bF7 constant (handoff custody decision).

title: A11 custody scripts (setup-kms.sh + move-xsgd.ts)
summary: Write scripts/setup-kms.sh (interactive wizard: create ECC_SECG_P256K1/SIGN_VERIFY key, attach a key policy allowing Sign only to signer-service's role, print the derived address) and scripts/move-xsgd.ts (transfer 30 XSGD from the FUNDING_ORIGIN_WALLET to the KMS-derived address, Fuji first).
acceptance: Scripts are written and typecheck; running them is human-blocked (AWS creds + the funding wallet).
notes: Use @straitsx/contracts FUNDING_ORIGIN_WALLET. Never commit or log key material. Follow the 'plain -m, no shell-special chars' rule if any commit message is written.

title: A15 docker-compose + isolation probe
summary: Add docker-compose.yml putting signer-service on an internal network joined only by policy-service, with agent-orchestrator on a separate network with no route. Add scripts/test-isolation.sh (wired to pnpm test:isolation) that runs a container on the orchestrator network, curls signer:4003/health, and asserts the connection is REFUSED.
acceptance: Orchestrator -> signer connection refused at the network layer; screenshot the refusal for the deck.
notes: Enforce at the network layer, not an if in code (conventions.md §2, execution_plan §11). Docker 28.0.1 is installed. This test is a deliverable, not hygiene.

title: A16 checkpoint-2 probe + latency measurement
summary: Write the checkpoint-2 probe: fetch a live sandbox challenge, build typed data, sign via the real KMS path, retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE, verify the settlement tx on Fuji via chain-gateway A8, and measure 202 -> settlement latency for Owner B (maxAuthValiditySeconds).
acceptance: Script written; running requires KMS + funded EXPECTED_SIGNER_ADDRESS (human-blocked).
notes: Sandbox challenge fetch is free and creates nothing (execution_plan §19.3). Hand the latency number to Owner B (check 7).

title: A18 production 402 probe script
summary: Write scripts/probe-production-402.ts to read the mainnet 402 and record asset, payTo, and extra.version into execution_plan §19.7. Do NOT inherit version '2' from Fuji.
acceptance: Script written and typechecks; running is blocked on organiser clearance for /production/sse.
notes: Refuse, never default (constants.ts §0 rule). Production costs real money — no iteration against production.

title: Replace 0x9f6B...1bF7 with EXPECTED_SIGNER_ADDRESS
summary: Update the pinned paying-wallet constant in api-contracts.md §0, execution_plan.md §19.5, and owner-a-tasks.md A11 to reference EXPECTED_SIGNER_ADDRESS (env) instead of the literal 0x9f6B4A5DE73CE365238F27236ea04A747E691bF7, per the handoff custody resolution.
acceptance: All three docs no longer assert derivedAddress == the literal; they name EXPECTED_SIGNER_ADDRESS and the Fuji-first custody move.
notes: Nothing external pins 0x9f6B...1bF7 (the 402 only names payTo). Announce the change to Owner B and Owner C.

title: A17 nonce strategy decision
summary: Decide random-and-reserved vs keccak256(requestId || policyHash || intentHash || merchantDomain) and record it in execution_plan.md §10. Recommend the commitment variant (chain-verifiable settlement).
acceptance: Decision recorded; Owner B told (policy-service computes the nonce — one line on their side).
notes: Must be decided before A16 (changing after a signature means a new nonce and a new authorization). No code either way.

title: Typecheck, full suite, code-review, commit message
summary: Run export PATH="$HOME/.foundry/bin:$PATH"; pnpm typecheck && LIVE_RPC=1 pnpm test && (cd packages/contracts-sol && forge test). Then code-review against fixed point 3fac64e. Then write a copy-pasteable commit message block (plain -m, no shell-special chars).
acceptance: typecheck exit 0; tests green; code-review findings addressed; commit message provided as a block.
notes: Do NOT run git commit (working agreement). Re-run the numbers; do not trust the handoff's 145/151. Use fixed point 3fac64e, not 5851eb3, to exclude Owner B's ~2,900 lines.
